title: Responsive creature
description: A violet network changes shape as it is fed, played with, or put to rest.
useCase: A small character that communicates state through topology and cadence.
interaction: Feed, play, and switch between rest and wake.
reducedMotion: Actions update a static state; breathing and connecting-line motion stop.
limitations: An illustrative character with finite responses, not a pet game or health model.
look: Purple line-drawn network creature, a dotted outline with crossing chords, on a flat acid-lime field with an italic serif title and monospace buttons.
motion: The outline wobbles and breathes continuously; feeding swells it with six shrinking satellite dots, play speeds the wobble, and rest eases it into a plain oval as chords fade.
adapt: `draw` builds the 42-point body from `state` (`time`, `sleep`, `food`, `play`), and `tick` eases `sleep` and decays `food` and `play` each frame. Tune the harmonic terms in `points` and the decay rates; replace the labels and palette.
